title: Triage board vitals
prompt: The triage board shows one flat row per visit. Write `solve(encounters)` so it returns each visit's id, heart rate, temperature, first diagnosis code and number of codes.
rules: `primary_code` is the first code in `diagnosis_codes` and `code_count` is how many codes there are.
Keep every visit. When vitals or codes are missing, those columns are missing too.
hints: `"vitals.heart_rate"` in `select` reads one field and names the column after it.
`F.size(...)` counts the items of an array. Name new columns with `alias`.
